workflow_yaml:
name: Jenkinsfile conversion

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write

env:
  APP_ENV: ci

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: gradle:8.7.0-jdk17-alpine
      options: --user root
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Prepare Tools
        run: apk add --no-cache bash git jq
      - name: Verify jq
        run: jq --version
      - name: Build
        run: ./gradlew --no-daemon clean build
      - name: Transfer build outputs to dependent jobs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: build/
          if-no-files-found: error

  unit-tests:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: gradle:8.7.0-jdk17-alpine
      options: --user root
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Prepare Tools
        run: apk add --no-cache bash git jq
      - name: Restore build outputs
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: build
      - name: Unit Tests
        id: unit_tests
        run: ./gradlew --no-daemon test
      - name: Publish JUnit results
        if: ${{ always() && steps.unit_tests.outcome != 'skipped' }}
        uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v5
        with:
          report_paths: build/test-results/test/*.xml
          fail_on_failure: true
          require_tests: true

  lint:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: gradle:8.7.0-jdk17-alpine
      options: --user root
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Prepare Tools
        run: apk add --no-cache bash git jq
      - name: Restore build outputs
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: build
      - name: Lint
        run: ./gradlew --no-daemon check

  publish-artifacts:
    needs: [unit-tests, lint]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: gradle:8.7.0-jdk17-alpine
      options: --user root
    steps:
      - name: Publish Artifacts
        run: echo 'Publishing artifacts (placeholder)'

  archive-artifacts:
    needs: [build, unit-tests, lint, publish-artifacts]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: gradle:8.7.0-jdk17-alpine
      options: --user root
    steps:
      - name: Restore build outputs when available
        if: always()
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: build
          if-no-artifact-found: warn
      - name: Archive JAR artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: archived-jars
          path: build/libs/*.jar
          if-no-files-found: error
assumptions: The source defines no trigger, so workflow_dispatch is used for evaluation; the main-branch condition is evaluated against the dispatched ref.
ubuntu-latest is an assumed host runner; the configured Gradle container is used for jobs, but its environment and tooling are not claimed to match Jenkins exactly.

GitHub jobs have separate workspaces, so each job checks out the source and the build job transfers its build/ directory to the parallel test and lint jobs. Jenkins workspace state such as Gradle user-home caches is not transferred.
The APK tool installation is repeated in test and lint jobs because their containers are isolated; jq --version remains in the sequential preparation stage.

The JUnit action publishes GitHub check-run/summary results rather than Jenkins JUnit UI. It is configured to fail for failed tests and missing test results; the report step runs after the test command even when that command fails.
The final artifact upload uses the literal Jenkins glob and errors when no matching JARs exist. GitHub artifact storage does not provide Jenkins fingerprinting.
Jenkins timestamps() has no exact equivalent here; GitHub Actions log timestamps may differ in format and behavior.

behavior_mapping.source: Docker agent uses gradle:8.7.0-jdk17-alpine with args '-u root'.
behavior_mapping.target: Each job's container image and options configure the same image with --user root.

behavior_mapping.source: Global environment sets APP_ENV to ci.
Checkout scm stage precedes all other stages.
behavior_mapping.target: Checkout step in build; isolated test and lint jobs also check out source before restoring build outputs.

behavior_mapping.source: Prepare Tools installs bash, git, and jq with apk and runs jq --version.
behavior_mapping.target: build job's Prepare Tools and Verify jq steps; tool installation is repeated in isolated test and lint jobs.

behavior_mapping.source: Build runs ./gradlew --no-daemon clean build after preparation.
Unit Tests and Lint run in parallel after Build; Unit Tests runs ./gradlew --no-daemon test and Lint runs ./gradlew --no-daemon check.
behavior_mapping.target: unit-tests and lint jobs both need build, so they can run concurrently; each restores build/ before running the original command.

behavior_mapping.source: Unit Tests always publishes build/test-results/test/*.xml, including after a test-command failure.
behavior_mapping.target: Publish JUnit results runs after the Unit Tests step even on failure and uses the same literal report glob, with failure-on-test-failure and required-test settings.

behavior_mapping.source: Publish Artifacts runs only on branch main and echoes the placeholder text.
behavior_mapping.target: publish-artifacts is guarded by refs/heads/main and runs the original echo after both parallel jobs succeed.

behavior_mapping.source: Pipeline post always archives build/libs/*.jar with fingerprinting enabled.
behavior_mapping.target: archive-artifacts runs after all stage jobs regardless of outcome, restores build outputs when available, and uploads the literal JAR glob; missing JARs fail the upload.
GitHub Actions log timestamp display is the closest platform behavior; exact Jenkins formatting is not preserved.
